backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Matka gambling platform, defining types and state for users, markets, bets, game results, deposit/withdrawal requests, and transactions, with public methods for user registration, profile retrieval, and platform operations.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms the old actor state (users, captchas, APK patch jobs) into the new actor state schema with empty maps for deposits, withdrawals, bets, game results, markets, game types, and transactions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (admin panel, market lobby, bet placement, etc.) to their corresponding frontend source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short descriptions of each frontend source file, summarizing the purpose of components, hooks, pages, and utilities in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base styles and OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Matka Pro frontend app, setting the page title, favicon, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for MarketLobby, BetPlacement, MyBets, Wallet, and AdminPanel, and wraps the app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, ThemeProvider, and a ProfileSetupGate modal.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Full-page access denied UI component with a red shield icon, styled error message, and a link back to the markets page for unauthorized admin panel access attempts.
frontend/src/components/BalanceDisplay.t: Empty file placeholder for a balance display component.
frontend/src/components/BetConfirmationD: A modal dialog that displays bet details (market, type, number, amount, expected payout) and prompts the user to confirm or cancel placing a bet, with a loading state during submission.
Renders a table of a user's past bets showing market, bet type, number, amount, status (won/lost/pending), payout, and date, with an empty state message if no bets exist.
frontend/src/components/BetNumberInput.t: A controlled numeric input component for entering a bet number, enforcing digit-only input and max length based on the selected bet type, with optional error display.
A grid of selectable buttons for choosing a Matka bet type (single, jodi, panna variants), displaying the label and payout multiplier for each option.
frontend/src/components/DepositForm.tsx: A form for submitting a deposit request with an amount (with quick-select buttons) and UTR reference number, validating inputs and calling the deposit mutation with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/DepositRequestsT: An admin table listing pending deposit requests with user ID, amount, UTR, and date, providing approve and reject action buttons with loading states per row.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout component rendering a sticky header with logo, navigation links (conditionally shown based on auth/admin status and wallet balance), and an outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, handling login, logout, and query cache clearing with loading state indicators.
frontend/src/components/MarketCard.tsx: Displays a single betting market as a clickable card showing its name, open/close times, and status badge, with disabled state for closed markets.
frontend/src/components/MarketManagement: Renders an admin table of all markets with their times and statuses, allowing toggling each market between open and closed via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PlatformStatsCar: Displays a grid of platform-wide statistics (active users, total bets, payout, deposits, withdrawals) as styled stat cards with icons.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to choose a username, submitting it to the backend to create their profile.
frontend/src/components/ResultDeclaratio: An admin form for declaring game results for a selected market by entering open number, close number, and jodi, then calling the declare result mutation.
frontend/src/components/TransactionHisto: Renders a sorted table of a user's transaction history with type badges, formatted amounts (credit/debit), and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/WithdrawalForm.t: A form component that allows users to submit a withdrawal request by entering an amount and UPI ID, with validation against minimum amount and available balance.
frontend/src/components/WithdrawalReques: An admin table component that displays pending withdrawal requests with approve/reject action buttons, using mutations from admin query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: A collection of React Query hooks for admin operations including fetching pending deposits/withdrawals, platform stats, and mutations for approving/rejecting requests and declaring game results.
A hook that fetches the authenticated user's bet history from the backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useBetQueries.ts: A hook providing a mutation to place a bet on the backend, invalidating bet history and user profile queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all markets, all game types, and a single game type from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Hooks for fetching and saving the authenticated caller's user profile via the backend actor, with query cache invalidation on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useWalletQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching transaction history and submitting deposit or withdrawal requests to the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines a dark Matka-themed design system with custom OKLCH color tokens, glow effects, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for platform stats, deposit/withdrawal request management, result declaration, and market creation/management, restricted to admin callers.
frontend/src/pages/APKEditor.tsx: Empty page component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/pages/BetPlacement.tsx: Bet placement page that lets authenticated users select a bet type, enter a number and amount, validate inputs, and confirm/submit a bet for a specific market.
frontend/src/pages/BlockchainExplorer.ts: Empty page component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/pages/CaptchaSolver.tsx: Empty page component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/pages/JobHistory.tsx: Empty page component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/pages/MarketLobby.tsx: Main market listing page showing a hero banner, login prompt for unauthenticated users, balance summary for logged-in users, and a grid of clickable market cards.
frontend/src/pages/MyBets.tsx: Authenticated user's bet history page displaying summary stats (total, won, pending) and a detailed bet history table with a refresh action.
frontend/src/pages/Wallet.tsx: Wallet page component that displays user balance, total deposits/winnings/withdrawals, and tabbed deposit/withdrawal forms with transaction history. Requires Internet Identity authentication; shows a login prompt if unauthenticated.
frontend/src/pages/Withdrawal.tsx: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a dedicated Withdrawal page.
frontend/src/utils/apkParser.ts: Empty file; intended as a utility for parsing APK files but contains no implementation.
frontend/src/utils/apkPatcher.ts: Empty file; intended as a utility for patching APK files but contains no implementation.
frontend/src/utils/currency.ts: Provides helper functions to convert between paise (bigint) and INR-formatted strings, and between rupees and paise. Includes legacy USD-named aliases for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/matkaOdds.ts: Defines Matka bet type odds multipliers, labels, and descriptions, and provides utilities to calculate expected payouts and validate bet numbers by type.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom Matka-themed colors (red, gold, dark surfaces), fonts (Bebas Neue, Poppins, Devanagari), box shadows, animations, and plugin integrations (typography, container-queries, animate).
project_state.json: Project state manifest (schema v1.0.0, version 3) describing the Matka gambling app's existing features, architectural notes, known issues, and image requirements for build planning.
